How long to keep holding before the action runs. Empty uses the default from Settings: 1000 ms.

Used when a long-hold action is selected.

Released earlier, the trigger counts as a tap; held longer, as a hold. Empty uses the default from Settings: 200 ms.

Not used when holding performs a long-hold action.
